summary: This directory centralizes the structural definitions and type schemas for document models and translation-related data. It provides the core data contracts used to represent documents, their sections, content blocks, and the metadata required for translation processes.
responsibilities: Define structural schemas for documents and their constituent sections
Model document content blocks such as paragraphs, lists, and code blocks
Specify the structure for translation requests and results
Provide TypeScript type definitions for all document and translation data structures
relationships: Documents are composed of one or more sections that hold various content blocks defined by content schemas.
Translation targets map specific document sections or fragments to required language results.
The schema definitions enable both validation of document structure and the generation of type-safe objects for processing.
designDecisions: Co-location of Zod schema constants with their corresponding TypeScript types
Use of barrel files to facilitate centralized access to schema definitions
Decoupling of structural document definitions from specific output formats
Strict modeling of translation requirements as schema-bound data requests
